what_happened.line: The Board of Health granted, by unanimous roll call, two local upgrade variances for the septic system at 73 Hollis Road.
The board authorized its administrative assistant to sign board members' names on septic permits the board has already approved, 4-0 with one abstention.
The agent is to talk with the Housing Authority about visitors at 131 White Street and recommend voluntary measures only, with no board order.
The administrative assistant is to check why Harvard's final rubbish regulations changed format and reformat the draft, with attorney review to follow.
An Arbor Street update is to go on a future agenda, possibly June 4.

why_it_matters: Septic variances and permit signing decide how quickly property owners can get approved septic work moving while meetings are held remotely.
The draft rubbish regulations could change local trash rules, and they have not yet been through attorney review or adoption.
watch_next: A possible June 4 agenda item on Arbor Street.
The reformatted draft rubbish regulations and the attorney's review.
